question: What is the pettiest revenge you have ever pulled off?
story: A guy in my office stole my lunch every Thursday for a month, so I ran for the one committee nobody wanted to be on. It was the facilities committee. Four people, one hour a month, free donuts. Everyone thought I was insane for volunteering. What they did not know is that the facilities committee assigns parking. Not officially. But we recommend, and HR just signs it. Kevin had spot number three. Front row, by the door, under the awning. I did not take it away from him, because that would have been obvious. I simply proposed a rotation, for fairness, for morale, effective immediately. Kevin has been rotating for two years. He has had spot forty one twice. He once had to park across the street during a hail storm. And every Thursday, my lunch is exactly where I left it.
